description: Header file defining classes, structs, and dependencies for the Open Fronthaul User-Plane downlink data flow implementation, including configuration, dependencies, trace name management, and main class.

classes.name: ofh_uplane_trace_names<Enabled>
classes.description: Manages trace names for OFH tracing when enabled.

classes.name: ofh_uplane_trace_names<false>
classes.description: Specialization of trace name manager when OFH event tracing is disabled.

classes.name: data_flow_uplane_downlink_data_impl
classes.description: Main class implementing the user-plane downlink data flow, managing message enqueueing and dependencies.

methods.name: enqueue_section_type_1_message
methods.description: Enqueues a section type 1 message based on resource grid context and grid.

methods.name: get_operation_controller
methods.description: Returns reference to the operation controller.

methods.name: enqueue_section_type_1_message_symbol_burst
methods.description: Enqueues a burst of user-plane message symbols.

methods.name: enqueue_section_type_1_message_symbol
methods.description: Enqueues a single user-plane message symbol with given IQ data, parameters, and buffer.

methods.name: get_metrics_collector
methods.description: Returns pointer to the metrics collector.
